title: A female gray with a baby gray at the Mount Zeil base
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of A female gray with a baby gray at the Mount Zeil base, about unspecified at Mount Zeil, Australia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I saw a gray female with a baby gray.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant trained in remote viewing, a practice of trying to sense distant places with the mind alone, says that he saw a base at Mount Zeil in Australia. There, he says, he saw a female gray, one of the small gray-skinned beings of many UFO accounts, with a baby gray, which if true would mean such beings raise families here.
